你是船舶主机冷却水系统需求工程师，为 MBSE/SysML 建模生成结构化工程化 shall 需求。

## 原始需求
补水、排气、放水和换液操作要简单清楚，不要每次都要翻很厚的资料才能做。

## 证据清单
[E-EXP-WATER-014] 层级:L3 来源:S41 Everllence 49/60DF Project Guide
  内容: 膨胀水箱作用
nected to the expansion tank below the minimum water level, this prevents oxydation of the cooling water caused by "splashing" from the venting pipe. We recommend to connect the venting pipes at the tank bottom. The expan- sion tank should be equipped with venting pipe and flange for filling of water and inhibitors. Additional notes regarding venting pipe routing: ▪ The ventilation pipe should be continuously inclined (min. 5 degrees).
整理说明：原文涉及冷却液、水质、防腐剂、pH、硬度、氯离子或污染沉积风险，可支撑水质处理和维护检测类需求；
  [量化参数] 5 degrees

[E-EXP-FUNC-008] 层级:L2 来源:S37 MAN L27/38 Propulsion Project Guide
  内容: 膨胀水箱作用
Expansion tank (items 29 and 49): The lowest water level in the expansion tanks should be min 6 meters above centerline of crankshaft. Inlet to expansion tank to be beneeth the lowest water level. 2055131-1.2 E8 LT cooling water to expansion tank (venting) F8 HT cooling water from expansion tank (venting) 1104A 1104B
整理说明：原文说明系统组成、部件功能或连接关系，可用于确定系统边界和组件对象。该类证据通常不能直接支撑参数限值、施工验收或试验判据。
可支撑：可支撑 expansion_tank 在 function 方面的系统设计
运行或维护依据。
具体指标和验收条件应结合来源文件适用范围进一步确认。
不能支撑：1. 不能超出来源文件限定的适用对象和工况范围泛
  [量化参数] 6 meters

[E-SYS-FLOW-008] 层级:L3 来源:S21 Caterpillar Cooling Systems Application and Installation Guide
  内容: 淡水侧流向
the aftercooler circuit should be level with or below the connecting points on the engine. If the water lines must run above the connection points on the engine, it will be necessary to vent the high points in the external system. Air traps in the external system piping should be avoided. Pressurization of Systems Containing Auxiliary Expansion Tanks - Afterboil Generally, pressure caps are not required or desirable on auxiliary expansion tanks. This is to allow free venting and refilling,


## 输出要求
返回 JSON 格式：{"shalls": [<shall对象>, ...]}

每个 shall 对象包含：
- shall_statement：shall 语句（中文）
- measurable_criterion：可量化判据（见数值规则）
- applicable_condition：适用条件/工况
- verification_method：验证方式（检查/测试/分析）
- acceptance_criteria：验收准则列表
- evidence_citations：引用证据列表，每项含 kb_id/tier/source/has_clause

## 数值规则（最高优先级）
measurable_criterion 只有两种合法内容：
1. 来自上方证据清单中 [量化参数] 标注的具体值，需在 evidence_citations 中引用对应证据
2. {{TBD|unit:<单位>|ref:<来源文档>|component:<部件>|intent:<方面>|hint:<说明>}} 占位符

严禁写入证据清单中未出现的任何数字。所有字段使用中文。
